title: Telefonni posilkada olsam?
caption: ❓ Savol: «Telefonni chetdan posilkada olsam, nima to'layman?» Ikki xil to'lov bo'lishi mumkin: 1️⃣ Bojxona to'lovi — telefon narxi oylik normadan oshsa • Kuryer orqali norma — oyiga 200 $ • Masalan, 350 $ lik telefon: (350 − 200) × 30 % = 45 $ (≈ 531 000 so'm) • 200 $ gacha bo'lsa va shu oyda boshqa posilka bo'lmasa — to'lov yo'q 2️⃣ UzIMEI ro'yxatdan o'tkazish — har qanday holatda • Tarmoqqa ulangandan keyin 30 kun ichida — 88 000 so'm • 30 kundan keyin — 110 000 so'm 💡 30 kun ichida ro'yxatdan o'tkazsangiz, 22 000 so'm arzonroq tushadi. 📅 2027-yil yanvaridan boj stavkasi 20 % — o'sha telefon uchun 30 $. 📄 Asos: PQ-4508, 3-band; VM 778-son, 17.09.2019, 6-ilova; BHM — PF-115, 23.06.2026 — lex.uz 📲 Telefon bojini ilovada hisoblang ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #savol
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#savol".
2) Center: a modern smartphone lying in an open matte cardboard parcel box, a small indigo tag reading IMEI hanging from the box, and a tiny shield with a checkmark floating beside it. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of sky blue (#38BDF8); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Telefon posilkada"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Boj va UzIMEI"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
